ops.oldText: EXCEPT FOR LIABILITY ARISING UNDER SECTION 8 OF THIS AGREEMENT, IN NO EVENT SHALL EITHER PARTY'S LIABILITY ARISING OUT OF THIS AGREEMENT OR THE USE OR PERFORMANCE OF THE SOFTWARE EXCEED THE TOTAL AMOUNT ACTUALLY PAID BY CORIO HEREUNDER FOR THE TRANSACTION WHICH THE LIABILITY RELATES TO DURING THE TWELVE (12) MONTHS IMMEDIATELY PRIOR TO THE FILING OF THE CAUSE OF ACTION TO WHICH THE LIABILITY RELATES.
ops.newText: EXCEPT FOR EXCLUDED CLAIMS, IN NO EVENT SHALL EITHER PARTY'S TOTAL AGGREGATE LIABILITY ARISING OUT OF OR RELATING TO THIS AGREEMENT OR THE USE OR PERFORMANCE OF THE SOFTWARE EXCEED THE GREATER OF (A) THE FEES PAID OR PAYABLE BY CORIO UNDER THIS AGREEMENT IN THE TWELVE (12) MONTHS IMMEDIATELY PRECEDING THE EVENT GIVING RISE TO THE CLAIM AND (B) ONE MILLION U.S. DOLLARS (US$1,000,000). "EXCLUDED CLAIMS" MEANS A PARTY'S BREACH OF ITS CONFIDENTIALITY, DATA PROTECTION OR SECURITY OBLIGATIONS, ITS INDEMNIFICATION OBLIGATIONS UNDER SECTION 8, ITS GROSS NEGLIGENCE, WILLFUL MISCONDUCT OR FRAUD, AND ITS INFRINGEMENT OF THE OTHER PARTY'S INTELLECTUAL PROPERTY RIGHTS. CORIO'S OBLIGATION TO PAY FEES DUE UNDER THIS AGREEMENT SHALL NOT BE SUBJECT TO THIS LIMITATION AND SHALL NOT CONSTITUTE DAMAGES FOR PURPOSES OF THIS SECTION 9.

input.comment: [Playbook] We have set the cap at the greater of twelve (12) months' fees paid or payable and US$1,000,000, applied to aggregate liability under the Agreement rather than only the amount actually paid for the single "transaction" at issue, which would make the cap illusory for most claims. We have also confirmed that indemnification, confidentiality/data security, gross negligence, willful misconduct, fraud and IP infringement sit outside the cap, and that Corio's fee payment obligations are not capped damages; a mutual 12-month fees cap with at least indemnity, confidentiality, gross negligence and willful misconduct carve-outs is our fallback.
input.summary: Make cap the greater of 12 months' fees paid or payable and US$1,000,000 on an aggregate basis, and add standard uncapped Excluded Claims.
